title: Nutrition in Plants and Animals
summary: How plants make food from sunlight, how other organisms get theirs, what our food contains, how we digest it, and how a balanced diet keeps us healthy.

ib.statementOfInquiry: All living things depend on a balanced supply of energy and nutrients; understanding nutrition helps us make healthy choices for ourselves and our communities.

factual: What do plants need for photosynthesis?
What happens to food in each part of the digestive system?
conceptual: How does a limiting factor control the rate of photosynthesis?
How does a balanced diet prevent deficiency diseases?
debatable: Should junk food be banned near schools?
Should millets replace some rice and wheat in Indian diets?
